summary: SMIC's majority-owned 300 mm logic foundry joint venture in Beijing's E-Town, agreed in July 2020. Phase 1 was planned at USD 7.6 billion for about 100,000 wafers a month at 28nm and above. SMIC reported pilot production by the end of 2022, with volume output delayed by late equipment. In February 2025 a land parcel reported as planned for Phase 2 was sold, with that project listed at no less than CNY 50 billion.

metrics.note: Two-phase total that Cailian Press attributed to Beijing E-Town; it sits below the USD 7.6 billion Phase 1 budget, so the two figures are not on the same basis.
Total for the project planned on the land sold in February 2025, from the listing documents.
Eventual 300 mm wafers per month for Phase 1.

milestones.note: Cooperation framework agreement with the Beijing E-Town management committee.
SMIC described the fab as under construction in August 2022 and in pilot production by the end of 2022; mass production was pushed back by one to two quarters because of delayed bottleneck tools.
A Beijing E-Town affiliate won an industrial parcel that a person close to SMIC said is planned for Phase 2; SMIC did not comment.

notes: The joint venture was formally set up in December 2020. Cailian Press cited a November 2023 E-Town report that Phase 1 was in use and that a Phase 2 main structure was complete with equipment going in; the sources do not say how that relates to the Phase 2 land sold in 2025. SMIC's results releases since 2023 do not report progress at individual fabs.

review.method: Independent AI-assisted review (Claude): re-opened every cited source, checked each statement against it and searched for newer reporting.
review.changes: Added the November 2023 report of Phase 2 construction and the December 2020 formation date to the notes, and flagged that the CNY 49.7 billion two-phase figure does not reconcile with the Phase 1 budget; no newer reporting was found.
